songs.title: Hot Cross Buns - Right Hand & Rhythm
songs.description: Preparation: open high E, steady beats and rests.

songs.title: Hot Cross Buns - First Fretted Notes
songs.description: At your own pace: open high E, then frets 2 and 4.

songs.title: Hot Cross Buns - First Musical Phrase
songs.description: The real opening: 4, 2, 0. Play, rest, then repeat.

songs.title: Hot Cross Buns - The Quicker Middle
songs.description: Four open-string eighths, then four eighths at fret 2.

songs.title: Hot Cross Buns - The Complete Tune
songs.description: The complete four-bar melody, played three times.

songs.title: Hot Cross Buns - First Bass
songs.description: Thumb on open low E, then the familiar melody. One note at a time. 50 BPM.

songs.title: Hot Cross Buns - Alternating Bass
songs.description: Alternate open low E and A-string fret 2 (B) under the familiar melody. 50 BPM.

songs.title: Hot Cross Buns - Melody Across Strings
songs.description: Keep high E frets 4/2; move melody E to B-string fret 5. Familiar E/B bass. 45 BPM.

songs.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb - The Melody
songs.description: Play the melody on the G and B strings.

songs.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb - First E Bass
songs.description: Keep the same melody.

songs.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb - Adding A-String Bass
songs.description: Keep the E-string bass.

songs.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb - Adding D-String Tones
songs.description: Add the written D-string tones: open for G, fret 2 for Em, fret 4 for D.

songs.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb - The Complete Fingerstyle Tune
songs.description: Play the full melody with the written G, Em and D chord voices.

songs.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - First Melody Notes
songs.description: Find six melody notes on the G, B and high E strings, without a timer.

songs.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - The Opening Phrase
songs.description: Recognise the opening two bars; play, rest and repeat.

songs.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - The Middle and the Ending
songs.description: Practise the ending and the middle before joining the tune.

songs.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - The Complete Melody
songs.description: Play the complete twelve-bar melody twice, without bass.

songs.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - First Low E Bass
songs.description: Add G bass on low E fret 3 while keeping the familiar melody.

songs.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - Adding A-String Bass
songs.description: Keep G bass and add C bass on A-string fret 3.

songs.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - Adding D-String Bass
songs.description: Add open D bass; choose between three bass strings.

songs.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - Filling the Gaps
songs.description: Practise gentle offbeat plucks over G, C and D.

songs.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - The Complete Fingerstyle Tune
songs.description: Join melody, G/C/D bass and light offbeat plucks.

songs.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - Optional: The F-Sharp Bass
songs.description: Optional: replace the D bass with F-sharp on low E fret 2.

levels.title: First Notes & Rhythm
levels.description: Open strings, your first fretted notes and a steady rhythm.

levels.title: Melody, Bass & First Chords
levels.description: Keep a familiar melody while building simple three- and four-note fingerstyle chords.

sublevels.title: Hot Cross Buns
sublevels.description: Your first solo melody, then thumb bass and two notes together.

sublevels.title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
sublevels.description: From the melody to E- and A-string bass, D-string tones and complete fingerstyle.

sublevels.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
sublevels.description: From six melody notes to E/A/D bass, gentle offbeat picking and an optional F-sharp bass.
